params.message:
The headers read are those of the page a visitor gets

www.sportbusinessgame.eu answers 301 to the apex, and that redirect comes
from the web server before any application: one header on the hop, all
four on the page behind it. The measurement read the hop, so a site that
had just done everything right looked like a site that had done nothing,
and the judge would have called a true claim false.

The header read now follows a redirect, at most three hops and never off
this site: a redirect elsewhere is another site's answer. The probes keep
following nothing, because there a redirect IS the answer and following it
would let another page's content count as a find.
